confirmed_root_causes: flow-guard-v40 used transform translateY to visually pull later sections upward; transforms do not remove their original layout slot, so giant blank gaps could remain.
stable-v040 did not actually load interaction-v40 in its critical loader despite handoff/build assumptions.
v0.4.0 kept the progress bar waiting for optional evaluation/ui/layout/phase scripts after the core dashboard was already rendered, producing stuck values such as 83%.
renderer_rule: Load full-recovery-v22.js exactly once. Never re-inject it from integrity/watchdog code.
interaction_rule: Load interaction-v41 before full-recovery and use delegated capture-phase clicks for fold/nav/modal close.
fold_contract: collapsed fold-body is display:none and takes zero content height
button toggles immediately between 펼치기 and 접기
fold state key uses mr:fold:v041: prefix
no gap repair may use translateY

loading.core_success_requirements: 16 sections + themes + at least 12 fold buttons + interaction-v41 ready
loading.success: 100.000% then hide load panel in about 0.42 seconds
loading.optional_scripts: evaluation/phase/layout/returns/cycle load after success and never hold progress

performance: compounder charts lazy-load only after unfold/viewport approach
compounder 1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y returns use one precomputed JSON request
optional analytics load after core UI
never run multiple full renderer boots concurrently
do not continuously mutate layout with watchdog transforms
hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION.
apk_done_definition: Actions success -> Artifact exists -> APK downloaded -> provide file directly to user
